attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Halcyon's File Resilience (FiRe) technology is designed to prevent ransomware from executing its core function of encrypting files by intercepting and terminating the malicious process at the kernel level.

identities.name: Halcyon
identities.description: A cybersecurity firm that launched a new anti-ransomware capability named File Resilience (FiRe), which operates at the Windows kernel level.

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: Vendor of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel, with which Halcyon's platform offers deeper integrations for a layered defense approach.

indicators.name: Halcyon Ransomware Encryption Blocked Alert
indicators.pattern:
title: Halcyon Ransomware Encryption Blocked
id: 2b9c1d8e-4f5a-4b6c-8d7e-9f0a1b2c3d4e
status: experimental
description: Detects an alert from the Halcyon platform indicating that a ransomware encryption attempt was intercepted and blocked at the kernel level.
references:
  - https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260728la12907/halcyon-launches-file-resilience-preventing-ransomware-encryption-before-it-starts
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  product: halcyon
  category: application
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'File Resilience'
    - 'Ransomware Encryption Blocked'
  condition: all of keywords
indicators.description: Detects alerts generated by Halcyon's File Resilience (FiRe) technology when it terminates a process attempting unauthorized file encryption. This indicates a prevented ransomware attack.
